summary: Implemented replay-only transport (pause/play, rewind 150, speeds 1/2/4, seek via snapshot-every-120 cache) and client MediaRecorder export (720×1280@30, MIME order + honest labels, progress/cancel/visibility pause). Wired ASCENT ReplayTransportBar + status badge + Restart/Export into ClimbScene. 24 unit tests pass invoking production code. nextStage: verifier.
goal: Climb replay should allow fast forwarding, rewind, pause/play. Export as mp4.

learnings.insight: ReplaySnapshotCache.seek clones the floor(target/120)*120 snapshot then steps ≤119; parity oracle is createMatch→drain countdown→apply inputs[0..target-1]. Mutating a returned state must not affect the next seek (clone-before-return).
learnings.action: Assert player.y/peakY/tick against the headless oracle across boundaries 0,119,120,121; reject source greps of SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL_TICKS as AC-6 proof.

learnings.insight: Implementer shipped 24 production-invoking unit tests (transport 10, snapshots 5, MIME 5, useClimb replay predicates 4); typecheck clean. AC-10 wall-clock speed windows and full MediaRecorder encode need browser/verifier harness — not covered by node vitest.
learnings.action: Verifier should map AC-10/AC-13–19 to browser checks; unit suite covers AC-3/6/7/9/15/17 helpers and NFR-8 transport:null contract via shouldCaptureReplayKey(!replaying)=false.

learnings.insight: useClimb returns transport:null when !replaying and only reads pause/speed/seek refs inside the rAF loop when replayInputs are present — live path accumulator is still accumulator += dt with no speed multiply.
learnings.action: Confirm live ClimbScene does not mount ReplayTransportBar / useReplayExport session chrome (enabled:false); do not require per-frame transport React updates on live play.

learnings.insight: Export success/error copy and filename extension come from pickExportMime().label/extension — WebM must never be labeled or saved as MP4. Countdown frames are skipped in encode (duration ≈ N/30).
learnings.action: Browser-check success toast shows Downloaded MP4|WebM matching the blob type; cancel must not download.

knownGaps: AC-10 wall-clock 2×/4× timing windows need a fake-clock or browser harness (not in node vitest).
AC-13–19 MediaRecorder encode/download/visibility are integration-level; unit tests cover MIME probe + helpers only.
Export uses HTMLCanvasElement (not OffscreenCanvas) for draw-helper type compatibility; still 720×1280@30 detached.
useClimb transport React view updates on every match tick while replaying (needed for seek bar); live path remains transport:null.

testResults.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/game/replayTransport.test.ts tests/game/replaySnapshots.test.ts tests/game/exportMime.test.ts tests/game/useClimb.replayTransport.test.ts
